meta.aciklama:
Elon Musk vs Sam Altman vs Dario vs Terminator! Who will be the first to create Super Intelligence and win $1,000,000,000,000 (that's trillion with a T!)

#aivideo #openai #claude #elonmusk

transkript.t: These three founders are here to build super intelligence and whoever gets there first wins one trillion dollars
How many GPUs is that but before they change the world their AIs have one simple challenge
Make the perfect omelet for Gordon Ramsay
Right. I've not had breakfast. So let's see what the nerds can do and I brought in someone who knows what happens when super intelligence goes wrong
That's Terminator. I'm only here to compete. Can I use him first up?
Open AI. Apparently their model was trained on the whole internet. But where's the egg? The egg comes with a plus plan
That's what I pay $20 full. Next up X AI. In two years all of humanity will be cooking this way. I
Don't think Gordon's cooking like that ever. Okay, five years. The important thing is that it's built safely
Let's try with the butter knife first
Knife danger. Oh no. I think Dario failed too
Perfect, it's working three attempts. No omelets seems like we're safe. I'll be back
